items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Erskine Hawkins and that band, the Bama State Collegians, was the number one band that they came to New York with.

ctx.x: Erskine Hawkins was a high note trumpet player. He was one of these trumpet players that he was a very quiet guy and until you heard him play you wouldn't even know what he was going to say or what he was going to do until he got in front of the bandstand. He was a very quiet bandleader, too. The band came from Bama State Teachers College in Montgomery, and they came to New York. It was a college band, actually. They had three bands down there, a number one band, a number two band, and a number three band. And…

And, of course, they came to New York to play the Savoy. They had a manager with them from the school. They came up here in a school bus. In fact, I was standing in front of the Woodside Hotel when they drove up from Alabama State to play in New York.
